title: Compute power and sample size using G*Power

cues.en: Instructor: There are many online calculators for computing statistical power and sample size.
cues.zh: 講師：計算檢定力與樣本數，有許多線上計算器。

cues.en: However, the kind of widely accepted best one, is called G Power or G * Power, and it has, the website is actually really long.
cues.zh: 但廣受接受、被認為最好的，叫 G Power 或 G*Power，網站網址很長。

cues.en: So, I'm not gonna just give you the URL.
cues.zh: 所以不直接給網址。

cues.en: The easiest way to find it is to Google search for G * Power calculator and I'm sure you'll find it.
cues.zh: 最簡單是 Google 搜尋 G*Power calculator，相信會找到。

cues.en: It comes from this statistics group in Germany.
cues.zh: 來自德國的一個統計團隊。

cues.en: And let's see, so, this is the main page.
cues.zh: 這是首頁。

cues.en: You can see that the URL is really long.
cues.zh: 網址真的很長。

cues.en: They could have done a better job with this, but that's okay.
cues.zh: 這部分可以做得更好，但沒關係。

cues.en: Anyway, it's free to download, and this team is really great.
cues.zh: 免費下載，這個團隊很棒。

cues.en: I don't know them personally, I'm not involved in the development of this product, but it's free, and yeah, you can download it works really well.
cues.zh: 我不認識他們，也沒參與開發，但免費，而且運作很好。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do now is illustrate to you one example application of this calculator, G Power's calculator.
cues.zh: 現在示範 G*Power 計算器的一個應用例子。

cues.en: So as I mentioned, it's free, it's cross platform, it's easy to, you just download it, you don't need to register or you know, do anything like that.
cues.zh: 免費、跨平台，很容易，只要下載，不需要註冊等等。

cues.en: Then it's gonna open up this window, and the font sizes are already a little bit on the small side for my screen.
cues.zh: 打開這個視窗，字體在我的螢幕上已經有點小。

cues.en: So, it may be mostly unreadable for you.
cues.zh: 你可能大部分都讀不清楚。

cues.en: If so, I apologize.
cues.zh: 如果如此，抱歉。

cues.en: But of course you can download this program on your own computer and then you'll be able to read this stuff.
cues.zh: 當然可以在自己電腦下載，就能閱讀。

cues.en: So, if you just look through these windows here, you can see there's a huge variety of tests that this power calculator will allow us
cues.zh: 查看這些視窗，可以看到它支援非常多種檢定，

cues.en: to run through.
cues.zh: 可以進行計算。

cues.en: So F-tests, and T-tests, and chi-squared tests, and zed tests.
cues.zh: F 檢定、t 檢定、卡方檢定與 Z 檢定。

cues.en: Let's just stick with T-test for now.
cues.zh: 先選 t 檢定。

cues.en: So then there is all of these various statistical tests that are based on the T-test family.
cues.zh: 有各種 t 檢定家族的統計檢定。

cues.en: So we have a bivariate regression of one group and we're looking at the size of a slope.
cues.zh: 單組雙變量迴歸，研究斜率大小。

cues.en: We have the difference between two dependent means.
cues.zh: 兩個相依平均值之差。

cues.en: So matched pair, this is something I've talked about here.
cues.zh: 也就是配對，之前談過。

cues.en: We have the Wilcoxon signed-rank test, that's something that I've also discussed here.
cues.zh: Wilcoxon 符號等級檢定，也討論過。

cues.en: So let's just pick one, let's say matched pair.
cues.zh: 選一種，例如配對。

cues.en: So I'm gonna go for the difference between two dependent means.
cues.zh: 兩個相依平均值之差。

cues.en: So this would be a paired samples T-test.
cues.zh: 也就是配對樣本 t 檢定。

cues.en: And then we can compute the type of power analysis.
cues.zh: 接著選檢定力分析類型。

cues.en: So then we have even more options.
cues.zh: 又有更多選項。

cues.en: And I'm gonna go for a priori power.
cues.zh: 選事前檢定力。

cues.en: So compute the required sample size given the alpha threshold, the power, and the effect size.
cues.zh: 給定 alpha 門檻、檢定力與效果量，計算所需樣本數。

cues.en: So, here we go.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: I'm gonna select two-tailed, I wanna do a two-tailed test.
cues.zh: 選雙尾，想做雙尾檢定。

cues.en: I'll set my effect size to be, let's say the effect size is gonna be around 0.8.
cues.zh: 效果量假設大約 0.8。

cues.en: I'll set the alpha, so it's called here alpha error probability, but that's basically our alpha threshold.
cues.zh: 設定 alpha，這裡叫 alpha error probability，基本上就是 alpha 門檻。

cues.en: We're gonna leave that at 0.05.
And the power here, one minus beta error probability, they have it set to 0.95 by default.
cues.zh: 檢定力，也就是 1 減 beta error probability，預設是 0.95。

cues.en: I'll try setting this to 0.9.
cues.zh: 試著改成 0.9。

cues.en: Let's see what we get.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: So now I click calculate.
cues.zh: 點 Calculate。

cues.en: And this is pretty neat, so it shows me the null hypothesis distribution, the alternative hypothesis distribution, the threshold here, two-tailed threshold that we're picking.
cues.zh: 很有意思，它顯示虛無假設分布、對立假設分布，以及選取的雙尾門檻。

cues.en: And, yeah, so then we find that we need a total sample size of 19 to achieve an actual power of 0.9,
cues.zh: 發現需要總樣本數 19，才能達到實際檢定力 0.9，

cues.en: based on an effect size of 0.8.
cues.zh: 以效果量 0.8 為基礎。

cues.en: So this is just one example use case.
cues.zh: 這只是一個使用例子。

cues.en: I encourage you to download this program and you know, try lots of things and it's pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 鼓勵下載程式，多試試，很有趣。

cues.en: It's pretty fun to play around with.
cues.zh: 操作起來很好玩。

cues.en: I'd like to close with just one statement.
cues.zh: 最後說一句。

cues.en: I am not involved in the development of this calculator.
cues.zh: 我沒有參與這個計算器開發。

cues.en: I've been using it for years because I think this group has worked really hard on this and it's a pretty solid thing, but I am not responsible for it.
cues.zh: 用了多年，因為覺得團隊很努力，工具相當可靠，但我不對它負責。

cues.en: If you have questions about how to use it, please do not ask me, you have to look online.
cues.zh: 如果有使用問題，請不要問我，要自己上網查。

cues.en: There's an online forum where you can ask questions, you can contact the developers.
cues.zh: 有線上論壇可以問，也能聯絡開發者。

cues.en: So I am merely recommending you this tool because I think it's really good.
cues.zh: 只是因為覺得很好，才推薦。

cues.en: It's quite widely used in the literature.
cues.zh: 在文獻中相當廣泛使用。
